initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 11833. additional_context: The value set template was later moved without content changes from source/template-vs.html to tools/templates/template-vs.html by 24e6675dcd. Current build.fhir.org output for valueset-item-type.html renders an abstract code in italics with a tooltip and includes the Code-column explanation from the template. Community searches found no human discussion or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current template source already states that italic codes are not selectable ('Abstract') across the relevant pages that carry the terminology/value set column explanation.
